messages.content: for ever ANNE What is it RICHARD That it may please you leave these sad designs To him that hath most cause to be a mourner And presently repair to Crosby Place Where after I have solemnly interred At Chertsey monastery this noble King And wet his grave with my repentant tears I will with all expedient duty see you For divers unknown reasons I beseech you Grant me this boon ANNE With all my heart and much it joys me too To see you are become

executioner RICHARD Then bid me kill myself and I will do it ANNE I have already RICHARD That was in thy rage Speak it again and even with the word This hand which for thy love did kill thy love Shall for thy love kill a far truer love To both their deaths shalt thou be accessary ANNE I would I knew thy heart RICHARD Tis figured in my tongue ANNE I fear me both are false RICHARD Then never was man true ANNE
